maya: just rescued this photo — Simba attempted a stealth ambush on the spider plant. no injuries, one leaf surrendered. https://photos.redwood/simba-plant-2790012345.jpg :laughing:
jon: that tiny murder loaf stare :rofl:
elaine: omg his whiskers are doing a whole thing. is the plant ok? :seedling:
maya: it lived to photosynthesize another day. casualty: one chewed edge. he sat in the pot for 3 mins then pretended nothing happened.
sam: plant: "I will file a complaint" :page_facing_up: (reaction :laughing:)
ops-bot: Image uploaded by maya: simba-plant-2790012345.jpg at 2026-03-22 14:05 UTC
jon: is that from the office pot-swap? looks familiar
maya: yep, erin's hand-me-down spider plant. naming contest? :thinking_face:
elaine: "Simba: The Botanical Bandit" is peak
sam: votes: Simba(2), Plant Pouncer(1), Leafy McSniff(0)
maya: tally updated ^^^
jon: also, offering the rescued leaf if anyone wants to re-pot it. free adoption.
maya: leaving it on the kitchen counter labelled "Simba evidence" :package:
sam: i'll grab it on my way out. will bring a tiny pot :seedling:
elaine: stealing the caption for my mom chat, credits to maya :grin:
